synthesis: Protein is a body-weight-dependent adequacy variable; higher intake has context-dependent effects on lean mass/strength, particularly with resistance exercise.
directness: high for RDA context; moderate for exercise effects
residual_uncertainty: optimal intake varies by age, activity and clinical context; dish basis unresolved

synthesis: Calcium adequacy supports bone biology, but routine calcium/vitamin D supplementation does not universally reduce fractures in community-dwelling older adults.
directness: high for requirement; moderate for supplement-fracture null
residual_uncertainty: food vs supplement and population context must remain separate

synthesis: Iron need and absorption are highly population- and source-dependent; pregnancy supplementation improves hematologic endpoints, while broader clinical-outcome evidence is limited.
consistency: high for requirement; moderate for pregnancy hematologic effect
residual_uncertainty: heme/nonheme fraction and individual iron status absent from dish data

synthesis: Folate-form semantics are essential: periconceptional folic acid prevents NTDs, but food folate, folic acid and DFE cannot be collapsed into one unlabeled μg field.
Dietary cholesterol is not a stand-alone numeric disease label; evidence and guidance require dietary-pattern and correlated-fat context.
directness: moderate for LDL effects; lower/uncertain for isolated CVD effect

synthesis: Purine restriction is a gout-specific, conditional lifestyle recommendation with low-certainty evidence; source type and overall management context matter.
consistency: moderate for flare association; low for intervention magnitude
residual_uncertainty: total purine is an incomplete proxy; diet usually has modest serum-urate effects
